Ages 12+   

Bend Ecstatic Dance is Every Thursday 
at Tula Movement Arts 
2797 NW Clearwater Drive
weeks.bio:
Inner Forest is an Oregon-based musician, DJ, and producer weaving ancient sound wisdom into forward-thinking electronic music. Drawing from global traditions and bass-driven experimentation, his work blurs the line between ceremony and dancefloor, offering immersive journeys that awaken the body, mind, and spirit. 
Each composition is crafted with intention, layering organic instrumentation, hypnotic rhythms, and visionary textures to guide listeners into altered states of connection and bliss. 
Inner Forest has performed alongside artists such as Beats Antique, CloZee, Desert Dwellers, Tipper, David Starfire, David Satori, Zoe Jakes, ill.Gates, Lafa Taylor, Nico Luminous, ill-esha, Trevor Kelly, Knowa Lusion, and The Human Experience. His music appears on High Vibe Records and Merkaba Music.
weeks.name: DJ Inner Forest
weeks.somaticBlurb:
Cacey Thomas, one of our greatest bodyBoss experts leads
Acro Contact Fusion this week with Loua

Explore the ooey-gooey space where therapeutic acro meets contact improv. We’ll begin with a grounding partner thai massage warm-up to drop in and connect. From there, we’ll stay close to the floor, learning to roll, melt, and transition in and out of acro yoga shapes. We’ll weave these movements into contact improv, exploring how acro poses can emerge naturally within a shared dance. Come ready to slow down, get playful, and discover new ways of moving together.

Our weekly eDance offers a facilitated movement experience called Soma Lab.
It’s included in the regular cost of entry.
Each Week:
7-7:45pm Soma Lab
8-10pm Ecstatic Dance
All together $22-18 Sliding Scale Payment

weeks.shortDescription: Warm, soulful setlists that hold the room gently and open space for the collective to arrive.
weeks.bio: Amanda Ramirez is a longtime member of the Bend dance community who curates warm, soulful setlists rather than mixing live — an evening shaped like a story.
weeks.name: Amanda Ramirez
weeks.setDescription: Earthy, melodic openings that rise into radiant, full-hearted release, then settle gently back to the ground. Expect goosebumps.
weeks.somaticBlurb: A guided contact-improvisation warm-up — explore weight-sharing, rolling points of contact, and moving in duet before the floor opens.

weeks.shortDescription: Pulsing, hypnotic electronic textures with a shimmer of the cosmic — hard to keep still through.
weeks.bio: Electric Indigo brings pulsing, hypnotic electronic textures with a shimmer of the cosmic — a DJ who loves a slow, patient build.
weeks.name: Electric Indigo
weeks.setDescription: Deep, driving grooves that arrive in waves: trance-tinged peaks, spacious breath-breaks, and a luminous comedown.
weeks.somaticBlurb: A gentle grounding yoga flow to open the hips, spine, and breath, easing body and mind onto the dance floor.

weeks.shortDescription: Organic house and downtempo woven into a slow-rising journey built for barefoot movement — textured, spacious, and deeply felt.
weeks.bio: Kalpa is a Bend-based DJ and movement facilitator drawn to organic, earthy sound. Blending live percussion textures with deep electronic grooves, they hold space for a floor to arrive, unwind, and let go together.
weeks.name: Kalpa
weeks.setDescription: A gentle opening wave, a slow build through tribal and organic house, a full-bodied peak, and a soft landing — a three-act arc from first breath to final stillness.
weeks.somaticBlurb: A somatic, sensation-led practice tuning into subtle movement and inner rhythm to help you arrive fully in the body.

weeks.shortDescription: Global rhythms and bass-forward grooves rooted in dance floors around the world.
weeks.bio: DJ Neoma spins global rhythms and bass-forward grooves rooted in dance floors around the world, with an ear for the unexpected.
weeks.name: DJ Neoma
weeks.setDescription: Percussive, hip-shaking, and full of surprise — a set that keeps the body guessing and grinning all the way through.
weeks.somaticBlurb: A playful acro-based warm-up building trust, balance, and partner flying — no experience needed, spotters provided.
